name: SAT Competition
description: A long-running benchmark competition for propositional satisfiability solvers, where participating systems are tested on fixed families of SAT instances and ranked by solved instances, runtime, and related performance criteria.
evaluation_method: number_solved, runtime, PAR2 score, portfolio performance
notes: A flagship benchmark series in formal reasoning and algorithmic search. The exact leaderboard depends on the competition year, track, and instance suite.
